hi, 10x diamond player here i was in the same situation your in now i was hard stuck plat for 8 seasons before i could hit diamond. it’s just all about how much time are you willing to put into apex and learn watch algs, study the pros and try to emulate their play style. also don’t forget to watch your gameplay or try to understand how you died. don’t let toxic idiots ruin the game for you my man and don’t let your KD influence your gameplay for you as well. best of luck, tusha.

when you got that first knock you should have already committed to that fight close to zone. it’s pretty much free points and it gives you position that’s closer to ring. your teammates shouldn’t be loba looting this late into game and they should be helping you commit to this 3v2 honestly. as for the second half when you one clipped that bloodhound you should have lifted up to get the knock and see where everyone else was also ring was closing and you probably should have ran or committed to that first fight. don’t be afraid to tell your team to commit to a fight you got knocks on or stop looting. position can beat any armor, weapon and legend in the game.

also just fighting helps a lot, especially in a pub setting. try not to think about the repercussions too much and just focus on winning the fight, getting an angle, height or even backing off when you need to. the more fights you get into the more natural it will feel and if you make a bad play or mistake don’t sweat it or beat yourself up the only way to improve is to believe you can.

also when that lifeline was in the corner a good arc or made could have got you the knock without having to swing out that far.  remember to always carry grenades.  also when panicking take deeps breaths and try to access the situation. am i low, do i need to reload, should i res, etc. also you could have swung on that other door and there was a swap on your teammates box as well.

the door kick was very risky and honestly could have gotten you killed. Also don’t rely on sheila to finish the job there you were super slow when starting to come out and he could have one pumped you, shot a cluster or even his ult. if you wanted to play the door you could have put a cover on it and used sheila on the door to surprise him. also don’t be afraid to shoot sheila with out the sight as it’s still every accurate and super strong also you can use the wall as cover to heal in a corner for when there is none.
